dag_infos.description: New Taipei resident indigenous population age and education counts. The 18-35 result is apportioned at query time because 15-19 and 35-39 cross the requested boundaries.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市十五歲以上現住原住民族人口教育程度（按年齡、性別、平地／山地）
data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 API
data_infos.dataset_description: 來源為 1224 筆年度×年齡×性別×屬性寬表，itemvalue5-itemvalue32 為 28 個教育程度計數。平地／山地保留於 breakdown，來源沒有行政區欄位，固定為新北市全市 area_code=65000。
data_infos.etl_description: Paginate with a browser User-Agent, resolve semantic aliases from the dataset field description, parse age labels as integer intervals, emit one fact per source education metric, and validate every 合計 = 平地 + 山地 cell. Apply a three-times-median scale guard using 15歲以上／合計／總計畢業 by year. Keep source age bands only; 18-35 apportionment is query-stage and no rate scaling is performed.
